q: A train's max speed is 60km/hr. It covers 320km in 8hr. Find the ratio of max speed to average speed.
A 75m train crosses a telegraph pole at 60km/hr. Find the time.
A 280m train at 60km/hr crosses a 220m platform. Find the time.
A man travels by train covering 1331km in 11hr. Find the train's speed.
A 110m train at 60km/hr passes a man running opposite at 6km/hr. Find the time.
Two trains start from the same point on parallel tracks, same direction, at 45,40km/hr. Find the gap after 45 minutes.
Trains 180m,240m at 40,50km/hr move in the same direction. Find the time for the faster to cross the slower.
An 84km/hr train crosses a woman walking opposite at 6km/hr in 4 seconds. Find the train's length.
Trains 210m,150m on parallel tracks, opposite directions, at 87,75km/hr. Find the crossing time.
Two trains of equal speed and equal length (120m each) cross each other (opposite directions) in 12 seconds. Find each train's speed.
sol: Relative distance=240m in 12s → relative speed=20m/s=2v → v=10m/s=36km/hr

q: Trains 110m,70m move towards each other at 40,32km/hr on parallel tracks. Find the time to cross from the moment they meet.
A train and a platform of equal length: the train crosses the platform in 2 minutes at 144km/hr. Find the train's length.
The ratio of two trains' speeds is 8:9. The second train covers 480km in 6hr. Find the first train's speed.
A 150m train crosses a 300m bridge in 30sec. Find the time to cross another 200m train (36km/hr) coming from the opposite direction.
sol: Own speed=450/30=15m/s. Relative speed=15+10=25m/s. Total length=350m. Time=14sec

q: A train crosses two bridges of 800m,400m in 100sec,60sec respectively. Find the train's length.
An 850m train crosses a man running in the same direction at 61.2km/hr in 25sec. Find the time to cross a 986m platform.
sol: Relative speed=850/25=34m/s. Own speed=34+17=51m/s. Platform time=(850+986)/51=36sec

q: A 378m train at 62km/hr crosses another train (55km/hr, opposite direction) in 26sec. Find the other train's length.
sol: Relative speed=117km/hr=32.5m/s. Total length=845m. Other train=845-378=467m

q: A 150m passenger train and a 60m goods train (54km/hr) cross each other (opposite directions) in 6sec. If the passenger train crosses an A-meter bridge in 45sec, find A.
sol: Relative speed=35m/s. Passenger speed=20m/s. Bridge: 150+A=900 → A=750m
